free_tier.stated: 500MB of storage and 1GB of data transfer per month on GitHub Free for private packages, storage shared with Actions artifacts; public packages are free

egress.terms: Private packages on GitHub Free: 1GB of data transfer per month (10GB on Pro and Team, 100GB on Enterprise Cloud); beyond the quota data transfer is billed for each GB, and with no payment method on file usage is blocked at the quota. Public packages are free, and Container registry storage and bandwidth is currently free. The per-GB price is not on the captured page: unverified.
